recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a portrait-first browser arena survival game titled "Ghost Call: Rulebreak Ridge." Preserve the mechanics of a top-down survival collector-combat loop: virtual thumbstick movement, grab nearby item, directional attack cone, enemies chase and damage on contact, score increases when enemies are defeated, three-hit game over, restart and collection index. Reinterpret the world as a Scream-style meta-horror mystery: the player is a genre-savvy final survivor answering an unknown caller, collecting alibis and slasher-rule props, fighting copycat masked chasers, and filling a suspect board. Use procedural canvas art, VHS scanlines, caller-ID cyan, blood red, cream mask shapes, suburban houses, ringing phone motifs, and mobile-readable HUD copy.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Game Truth
- genre: top-down mobile arena survival / collection-combat game.
- objective: survive while grabbing items, using held items to strike pursuing enemies, and raising score by defeating them.
- input model: left virtual thumbstick plus GRAB and STRIKE/BREAK buttons; keyboard arrows/WASD plus grab/attack keys also work.
- core loop: spawn player, spawn collectibles/weapons and enemies, move, grab nearby item, strike in facing cone, score on enemy defeat, occasionally spawn more pickups.
- fail/friction state: player has three health hearts; enemies hurt on contact; zero hearts triggers game-over screen with restart/menu options.

## Protected Mechanics
- Continuous movement speed, friction, world bounds, camera follow, spawn cadence, enemy chase behavior, pickup radius, held-item behavior, attack cone, cooldowns, enemy damage/knockback, score increments, three-hit loss, restart/menu/index flows.

## Safe Theming Surfaces
HUD language, title/menu copy, item names, rarity names, storage key, procedural colors, player/enemy/pickup drawing, background motifs, button labels, toast copy, and index-board vocabulary are safe to transform.
